narrative.headline: The Oilers are the team on the rise
narrative.blurb: 51 games on this week's slate. The Hurricanes are No. 1 at 12-2-2 with a +27 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Lightning on 18 points. The West's last spot is the Blues on 15 points. The Oilers lead the heat check at 3-0-0 and +11 goals over the last three games.
